note: Both are complete, but X has small misreadings ('ἀπηληγκότας' for 'ἀπηλγηκότας', 'διακελήρωνται' for 'διακεκλήρωνται', 'ἐξομοιοῦ' for 'ἐξομοιῶν') that Y gets right.
X's apparatus note reads '7. παῖξαι cod. et ed.' where the leaf prints 'πέξαι cod. et ed.', which reverses what the note reports; X also has 'accubituun' for 'accubituum'.

X misreads 'Ac Aleæ quidem' as 'Alex', 'Archemorus' as 'achemorus', 'Cepheo' as 'Cepheu' and 'faciũt' as 'facit', and garbles the Greek 'Ἡγεμόνην'; Y has only minor slips ('Hippia', 'Quæ', 'iamdidum').
The leaf is blank apart from mirrored show-through, which X records correctly; Y transcribes the title page from the other side as text and partly invents it ('ΚΑΙ ΤΑ ΝΟΗΜΑΤΑ', 'MEDITATIONE').
Y misreads 'Aristotelei' as 'Aristoteli', 'Ἐρετριέα' as 'Ἐρέτρια', 'βράδην… βραδέα' as 'βράβην… βραβέα' and 'APOPHTHEGMATA', and drops 'ed.' before 'Schweigh.'; X matches the leaf.
The leaf reads 'Numerus Ἐπιμήκης… seu προμήκης', but X gives 'Numerus Προμήκης', which removes the distinction between the two terms; otherwise the two texts agree.
Y garbles the rubric ('συνήγοροι οἱ ἀφʹ' for 'συνήγαγον οἱ ἀρχ.'), leaves out 'ὁ Ἰησοῦς' after 'ἃ ἐποίησεν' and has 'πιστεύουσιν'; X follows the leaf.
In the verses X reads 'terra sinum' and 'quoque sinus erat' where the leaf prints 'terra virum' and 'quoque vivus erat', which changes the epitaph's sense; X also has 'hianti' for 'hiati'.

X invents wording from line 1 on ('βίοις καὶ πηγὴν νοερὰν' for 'λίμοις καὶ τὴν ὁμοειδῆ', 'ἀγαθοῖς καὶ φαύλοις' for 'αἰσθήσει καὶ φαντασίᾳ'); Y follows the hand much more closely, though it has errors of its own.
The two are nearly identical; X has 'ὁ δὲ' for 'ὁ δ’', 'ἀμφιβάλων' and 'προσπίπτειν' where the leaf reads 'προσαπαντᾷν', none of which changes the meaning much.
